Mokama vidhayak anant sinh ki beti shivangi ke tilak samaroh men mehmanon ke svagat ke lie khas intjam kie gae hain. is shahi aayojan men mehmanon ke lie 100 se jyada lajij vyanjan parose jane ki taiyari hai.
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
